tasks.title: Define pack/manifest.json schema in INTERFACE.md
definition_of_done: INTERFACE.md exists in repo root.
Manifest section lists required fields with types and constraints.
repo_commit fallback of "unknown" and created_at RFC3339 are documented.
Minimal manifest example JSON included.

recommended.approach: Keep schema descriptions precise and machine-oriented; prefer tables or bullet lists.

tasks.title: Define pack/index.json schema in INTERFACE.md
definition_of_done: Index section lists files entry fields: path, sha256, size_bytes, token_est, score, selected.
Index section documents total_token_est and its relation to file entries.
Minimal index example JSON included.

recommended.approach: Keep types explicit (string, integer, boolean) and mark required fields.

tasks.title: Define pack/context.md and pack/policy.md formats in INTERFACE.md
definition_of_done: Context block format documented with required metadata keys and delimiter lines.
Documented semantics for lines range, truncated flag, and git commit.
Policy.md documented as an empty file in Phase 1.

recommended.approach: Describe the block layout line-by-line and include a short example.

tasks.title: Define pack/lint.json schema in INTERFACE.md
definition_of_done: Lint section lists issues entry fields: id, severity, message, files.
Severity constrained to info|warn|error is documented.
Minimal lint example JSON included.

recommended.approach: Keep lint schema minimal; avoid suggesting extra severity levels.

tasks.title: Create assembly/examples/pack-minimal/ sample pack
definition_of_done: Directory assembly/examples/pack-minimal/ exists with manifest.json, index.json, context.md, policy.md, lint.json.
Sample contents match INTERFACE.md schema and are internally consistent.
policy.md is present and empty.

recommended.approach: Use a tiny, consistent example with one file entry and one context block.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic file inventory, scoring, and pack/index.json
definition_of_done: Include/exclude globs are applied with defaults and repo-relative POSIX paths.
File class priority and ASCII path ordering drive deterministic scoring.
Each index entry includes path, sha256, size_bytes, token_est, score, selected.
total_token_est equals the sum of token_est across files.

recommended.approach: Build a stable candidate list first, then derive scores and hashes in one pass.

tasks.title: Generate pack/context.md with deterministic snippet selection and truncation
definition_of_done: Selection walks scored files in order until max token budget is met.
Each selected file emits one snippet with correct lines range and truncated flag.
Context blocks include path, lines, git, score, truncated metadata.
Snippet ordering is stable and matches the index scoring order.

recommended.approach: Track remaining token budget and compute line ranges after truncation.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 2 lint rules for duplicate and contradictory directives
definition_of_done: Duplicate "do not" rules across docs are detected and reported.
Contradictory "must" vs "must not" rules in classes 1-4 are reported.
Issues use stable id values and severity limited to info|warn|error.
pack/lint.json ordering is severity then id, deterministic across runs.

recommended.approach: Normalize case and whitespace before matching directive lines.

tasks.title: Wire assembly build CLI to emit deterministic pack outputs
definition_of_done: assembly build reads repo, task input, include/exclude, out, max-tokens, task-id.
pack/manifest.json reflects inputs, outputs, repo_commit, created_at, tool_version.
pack/policy.md is emitted as an empty file.
All pack files are written under the requested out directory with stable paths.

recommended.approach: Build outputs in memory, then write to disk in a fixed order.

tasks.title: Add Phase 2 determinism acceptance tests
definition_of_done: Running assembly build twice produces identical pack outputs except manifest.created_at.
context.md ordering and index.json ordering are stable across runs.
lint.json severities are constrained to info|warn|error with stable id ordering.

recommended.approach: Freeze inputs and compare normalized outputs with created_at stripped.
